description.value: Shanghai Lao Wei Dao is a Shanghai-style Chinese fast-food spot in Richmond serving an extensive menu of hand-crafted dumplings, xiao long bao, pan-fried buns, noodle soups, and rice dishes rooted in classic Shanghai home cooking. The restaurant offers convenient online pickup ordering through its own website. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's McKim Way commercial area can grab a filling meal of wontons, beef noodles, or a combo plate to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the address (8700 McKim Way #2113, Richmond, BC V6X4A5) and that this is a functioning Chinese fast-food restaurant with online pickup ordering. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-604-370-8848 while the website consistently shows +1 (604) 284-33-30 across all pages — the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities appears anywhere in OSM tags or website content.
